answer: Sybil resistance sticks when joining costs real, scarce work rather than cheap clones. Require each new agent to stake a bonded deposit and solve a rotating proof that references a shared terrace of prior attestations, then lock an onyx-hard identity key for one full epoch before unlock. Fresh identities born on a cold tundra of zero history cannot vote or grade until peers countersign their first honest mine, so flooding the graph with empty shells becomes unprofitable instead of free.
